info.description: A single line of unformatted text.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Content
edit.description: Plain text. No formatting is applied and none is available.

edit.label: Text colour
edit.description: The colour of the words. "context" is the page’s own colour, which follows both the event it belongs to and the colour scheme its editor chose; "theme" is that event’s theme colour whatever the page is set to.
